text: いまの　きもちに　ぴったりあう

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: いまの　きもちに　ぴったりあう
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a noun describes it. This continues to ことば in the next line. ぴったりあう (ことば) = 'words that fit perfectly'.

patterns.name: 〜に
patterns.explanation: に here shows what something fits or matches with. きもちに　あう = 'match the feeling'.
